items.title: 80,000-year-old “arrowheads” rewrite human history
items.summary_raw: Archaeologists have identified tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used like arrowheads. items.title: Some joints may be primed for rheumatoid arthritis before birth

items.title: Harvard scientists turn knitting into shape-shifting smart fabric
